tasks.title: Birthday activity with a friend
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English-speaking friend, Mia, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Birthday plans!
paragraphs: Hi! My birthday is next Saturday and I want to do something fun with you. We have two options: go to the new escape room in town or have a picnic in the park. Which one do you prefer? Also, what time should we meet? And do you think we should invite a few other friends or keep it just the two of us? Let me know!

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which activity you prefer and explain why.
Answer her question about other guests.
Ask her if she needs help with anything for the birthday.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mia using all the notes.

tasks.title: Favourite annual event
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: You see this notice on a local English-language magazine website.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: What is your favourite annual event in your town or city? It could be a festival, a sports competition, a market, or something else.
Tell us what happens at this event and why you like it so much. Also, who would enjoy it most?
Write an article and we will publish the best ones in our magazine!

tasks.title: An unexpected phone call
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.

promptBlocks.label: Your story must begin with this sentence:
promptBlocks.text: The phone rang just as we sat down for dinner, and everyone looked at it.
